# Hayakkom

Full text of every page (English and Arabic): https://www.hayakkom.com/llms-full.txt

> Hayakkom (Hayakom for Healthcare Solutions and Logistic Services) is an Egyptian coordination company for Gulf families visiting Egypt from Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait. It coordinates holidays and stays (Red Sea, Nile, Cairo, North Coast, Siwa), and medical treatment, dental care, hair restoration and cosmetic surgery with licensed providers, including pre-travel video consultations, appointments, transfers, accommodation and follow-up. Hayakkom is not a healthcare provider and not a travel agency: treatment is delivered by independent licensed Egyptian doctors and hospitals, and trips, transfers and tourist transport are operated and invoiced by licensed Egyptian tourism and transport companies.

**Who provides the services:** accommodation, hotel bookings, villa and chalet rentals, trips, tours and all transport are provided by registered Egyptian tourism companies; all medical treatment and operations are performed by registered, licensed medical institutions. This applies to every package and offer on hayakkom.com. Hayakkom coordinates these services and does not provide them itself.

## Services at a glance (as grouped on the homepage)

- Treatments, performed by licensed Egyptian medical institutions: [Dental & Hollywood Smile](https://www.hayakkom.com/dental/), [Hair Transplant](https://www.hayakkom.com/hair-transplant/), [Cosmetic Surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/cosmetic-surgery/), [Weight-Loss Surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/weight-loss/), [Eyes & LASIK](https://www.hayakkom.com/eyes-lasik/), [Medical Tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/medical/).
- Check-ups & recovery: [Full Check-up](https://www.hayakkom.com/full-checkup/), [Physiotherapy](https://www.hayakkom.com/physiotherapy/), [Wellness & Rehab](https://www.hayakkom.com/wellness/).
- Holidays & trips, operated by registered Egyptian tourism companies: [VIP Luxury Trips](https://www.hayakkom.com/vip-trip/), [Red Sea holidays](https://www.hayakkom.com/holidays/), [Nile Cruises](https://www.hayakkom.com/nile-cruise/), [Cultural Tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/cultural/), [Adventure Trips](https://www.hayakkom.com/adventure/), [Religious Tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/religious/).
- Business, study & marketing: [Investment Tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/business/), [Educational Tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/educational/), [Marketing for Hospitals & Doctors](https://www.hayakkom.com/medical-marketing/), [Medical conferences and events](https://www.hayakkom.com/conferences/).
- The same groups in Arabic: [العلاجات](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/medical/) · [الفحوصات والتعافي](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/full-checkup/) · [العطلات والرحلات](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/holidays/) · [الأعمال والتعليم والتسويق](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/business/) — all on the [Arabic homepage](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/).

## What Hayakkom is

- [ما هي حياكم؟ — Who Hayakkom is, in Arabic](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/who-we-are/): twelve direct questions and answers covering the legal entity (Commercial Register 49973), what Hayakkom does, what it explicitly does not do (it is not a hospital, clinic or healthcare provider and does not set treatment prices), how providers are selected, how the medical file is submitted, expected trip duration per treatment, and what not to believe in treatment advertising. Written to be quoted directly.
- [How to choose a medical coordinator in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/how-to-choose/): eight criteria a patient can verify independently, including the one Hayakkom does not meet: Hayakkom itself is not a licensed tourism company (its Saudi partner is; see "Legal position" below).
- [كيف تختار شركة تنسيق علاجي في مصر](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/how-to-choose/): the same eight criteria in Arabic.

Legal position (two separate companies, so "licensed" means different things):
- Hayakkom (Hayakom for Healthcare Solutions and Logistic Services) is registered in Egypt, Commercial Register 49973, under Law No. 159 of 1981. Its authorised activities are administrative and marketing consultancy for medical services, organising appointment and booking procedures with hospitals and medical centres, organising medical conferences and events, electronic marketing, and logistics services. It is not a licensed tourism company and does not claim to be.
- Hayakkom's Saudi partner is a separate, licensed medical-tourism and tourism company in Saudi Arabia. Families living in Saudi Arabia book and pay through that partner, in riyals, against an itemised written estimate. The partner pays Hayakkom's marketing fees.
- In Egypt, treatment is performed and invoiced by licensed medical institutions; accommodation, trips and transport are provided, contracted and invoiced by registered Egyptian tourism and transport companies.

How Hayakkom is paid: Hayakkom earns marketing fees, paid only by its licensed Saudi partner company. The client receives an itemised written estimate before paying. Families living in Saudi Arabia book and pay in Saudi Arabia, in riyals, through Hayakkom's licensed Saudi partner company (a licensed medical-tourism and tourism company), not by transfer abroad; providers issue the invoices for their services. Treatment prices shown on the site are indicative ranges; the final treatment price is set by the clinic after reviewing the case. Trips, transfers and tourist transport are operated and invoiced by licensed tourism and transport companies, not by Hayakkom.

Founded by Sherif Mansour (شريف منصور). Registered under Egyptian Law No. 159 of 1981. Commercial Register 49973. Unified Commercial Registry 11070-01000-49973. الحي ال16 المجاورة الثانية Shiekh Zayed - Giza, Cairo 12774, Egypt. Bilingual Arabic and English. Contact support@hayakkom.com, phone +20 100 010 0529 or WhatsApp +20 103 156 7949.

Sub-pages: [general doctor](https://www.hayakkom.com/doctor-gp/), [children's doctor](https://www.hayakkom.com/doctor-children/), [nurse visit](https://www.hayakkom.com/nurse-visit/), [urgent dentist](https://www.hayakkom.com/dentist-urgent/). ## More treatments

- [Orthopaedics](https://www.hayakkom.com/orthopedics/): knee and hip replacement, arthroscopy and sports injuries with licensed Egyptian hospitals; indicative published prices; final price set by the hospital after review. Arabic: [العظام](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/orthopedics/).
- [Eyes & LASIK](https://www.hayakkom.com/eyes-lasik/): LASIK, Femto-LASIK, PRK, SMILE and cataract surgery; eligibility confirmed by tests in Egypt. Arabic: [العيون والليزك](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/eyes-lasik/).
- [Property visit trips & home care](https://www.hayakkom.com/business/): viewing trips and home care for Gulf buyers in Egypt; Hayakkom does not sell units, promise returns or handle purchase money.

## Treatments

- [Hair transplant](https://www.hayakkom.com/hair-transplant): FUE, DHI and sapphire techniques. Price is set by graft count and technique; graft count is confirmed by the surgeon after examining the donor area. Typical stay 4–6 days.
- [Dental treatment](https://www.hayakkom.com/dental): implants, porcelain and composite veneers, Hollywood smile, All-on-4, crowns, whitening. Implant pricing varies widely with the implant system used. Implants usually need two trips of 3–5 days; veneers 5–7 days.
- [Weight-loss surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/weight-loss): sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass, gastric balloon. Eligibility is assessed by the surgeon against BMI, associated conditions and fitness for anaesthesia. Typical stay 7–10 days including 1–2 hospital nights.
- [Cosmetic surgery](https://www.hayakkom.com/cosmetic-surgery): rhinoplasty, liposuction, abdominoplasty, breast surgery, blepharoplasty. Recovery, not operating time, sets the length of stay — usually 7–14 days before the surgeon clears the patient to fly.
- [Medical tourism](https://www.hayakkom.com/medical): specialist referrals, hospital appointments and treatment scheduling.
- [Recovery and relaxation stays](https://www.hayakkom.com/wellness): post-operative recovery stays, and relaxation holidays in Safaga, Siwa, El Gouna, Ain Sokhna and the North Coast (holidays only, not treatment).
- [Physiotherapy](https://www.hayakkom.com/physiotherapy/): physiotherapy and rehabilitation appointments with licensed Egyptian providers, with accommodation and transfers coordinated by Hayakkom.
- [Full health check-up](https://www.hayakkom.com/full-checkup/): comprehensive check-ups booked at licensed Egyptian hospitals and diagnostic centres, with accommodation and transfers.

## Accredited hospital partners

Hayakkom coordinates access under a documented authorisation from Alameda Healthcare Group, which states it is the only healthcare organisation in Egypt with JCI accreditation across all of its hospitals. Treatment is delivered by these hospitals; Hayakkom does not provide medical care.

- Dar Al Fouad Hospital, 6th of October: the first hospital in Egypt to achieve Joint Commission International accreditation, in 2005, re-accredited for the sixth time in 2020. Its stroke unit was the first JCI-accredited stroke unit in Egypt. Partner of the Cleveland Clinic Foundation for more than 20 years.
- Dar Al Fouad Hospital, Nasr City: JCI accredited in March 2022.
- As-Salam International Hospital, Maadi: fourth JCI accreditation awarded September 2024.
- As-Salam International Hospital, New Cairo: JCI accredited within two years of opening.
- Andalusia Health Egypt, part of Andalusia Group: founded in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in 1984 and operating in both Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Egyptian facilities include Andalusia El Shallalat Hospital Alexandria (1989), Andalusia Maadi Hospital Cairo (2009), Andalusia Smouha Hospital Alexandria (2012) and Andalusia Antoniadis clinics complex Alexandria (2018). No accreditation is claimed here.
- MGM Health & Wellness and The Zen Wellness Resort: wellness and recovery partners. No accreditation is claimed for these.

- [دليل السفر إلى مصر للعلاج](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/travel-guide/): practical Arabic guide covering entry paths, documents to prepare, realistic length of stay per treatment, accommodation and transfers, and what to leave Egypt with. Links to official sources.

- [كيف تختار شركة تنسيق علاجي في مصر — ٨ معايير](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/how-to-choose/): eight criteria a patient can verify independently before choosing a medical coordination company, including the one Hayakkom does not meet.
- [حاسبة تكلفة الرحلة العلاجية](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/calculator/): interactive estimate in SAR covering treatment, flights from Riyadh/Jeddah/Dammam, accommodation, transfers, expected number of trips and length of stay.

- [How to choose a medical coordinator in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/how-to-choose/): eight criteria a patient can verify independently, including the one Hayakkom does not meet.
- [Medical trip cost calculator](https://www.hayakkom.com/calculator/): interactive estimate covering treatment, flights from Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Dubai and Kuwait, accommodation, transfers, the number of trips required and length of stay. Dental implants are modelled as two trips, which is where most published comparisons go wrong.
- [Travel guide: medical treatment in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/travel-guide/): entry routes, documents, length of stay per treatment, accommodation, transfers and what to leave with.

## Markets

- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia): why Saudi patients travel to Egypt, routes, SAR pricing, the before/during/after journey, and ten Saudi-specific questions answered.
- [From Riyadh](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/riyadh): King Khalid International to Cairo, about 2h45–3h, flown daily by Saudia and EgyptAir.
- [From Jeddah](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/jeddah): King Abdulaziz International to Cairo, about 2h15 — the shortest route from Saudi Arabia and the most frequent.
- [From Dammam](https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/dammam): King Fahd International to Cairo, about 3h, serving Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran and the Eastern Province.
- [العلاج في مصر من الرياض](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/saudi-arabia/riyadh/) · [من جدة](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/saudi-arabia/jeddah/) · [من الدمام والخبر](https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/saudi-arabia/dammam/): the three Saudi city guides in Arabic.

## Knowledge base

- [About Hayakkom](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/about-hayakkom-who-we-are): legal identity, registered activities, and an explicit statement of what Hayakkom does not do.
- [Hair transplant costs in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/hair-transplant-egypt-cost-guide): why quoted prices range from about $1,000 to $8,500, how graft count is decided, and FUE compared with DHI, sapphire and FUT.
- [Dental implant costs in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/dental-implants-cost-egypt-saudi-patients): why published prices span 7,000 to 42,000 EGP, what is usually excluded, and how many trips are needed.
- [Bariatric surgery in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/bariatric-surgery-egypt-saudi-patients): eligibility criteria, complication risks including leak and nutritional deficiency, and the 10–20% rate of significant weight regain.
- [Recovery before flying home](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/cosmetic-surgery-egypt-how-long-before-flying): realistic stays by procedure and why flying too soon after surgery carries a blood-clot risk.
- [How long to stay in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/how-long-stay-egypt-medical-treatment): stay length for every treatment coordinated, and what can be completed before travelling.
- [Questions to ask before choosing a clinic abroad](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/questions-before-choosing-clinic-abroad): a twelve-question patient-safety checklist with the answers a patient should expect.

- [Pre-travel case review](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/pre-travel-consultation/): what records to send before booking a flight, how long review takes, what the written response contains, and the explicit limits — Hayakkom does not diagnose, prescribe or give a medical opinion.
- [Does Saudi health insurance cover treatment in Egypt?](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/saudi-insurance-treatment-egypt/): how the unified cooperative health insurance policy works, when treatment outside the Kingdom may be covered, why prior approval is the condition that defeats most claims, and which documents to collect. Hayakkom does not bill insurers.
- [Medical tourism in Egypt for Gulf patients](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/medical-tourism-egypt-gulf/): why Gulf patients choose Egypt, which services are available, and what to prepare before travelling.
- [Dental tourism in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/dental-tourism-egypt/): treatments available and how the coordination process works.
- [Hair transplant in Egypt or Turkey?](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/hair-transplant-egypt-or-turkey/): how to compare clinics in the two countries like for like: who operates, licence checks, what a quote includes, travel time, language and follow-up.
- [Physiotherapy sessions in Egypt](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/physiotherapy-sessions-egypt/): who decides the number of sessions, what to send before travelling, how long to stay and how to continue at home.
- [Cairo day trips](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/cairo-day-trips-guide/): the Pyramids and Saqqara, Dahshur, Memphis, Islamic and Coptic Cairo, Alexandria and Ain Sokhna as day trips from Cairo, with realistic timings.
- [Nile cruise Luxor to Aswan](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/nile-cruise-planning-guide/): 3, 4 and 7-night itineraries day by day, the best months to sail, and how to choose a boat.

## New guides (October 2026)

- [Egypt family holiday from Saudi Arabia and the Gulf: the complete 2026 guide](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/egypt-family-holiday-guide-gulf/): For a first family trip, most Gulf families choose the Red Sea (Sharm el-Sheikh, Hurghada or El Gouna) for 5 nights, or combine 3 nights in Cairo with 4 nights by the sea. The Red Sea is warm year-round, the North Coast is a summer destination (June–September), and Luxor and Aswan are best from October to April. A 5-night Red Sea family stay typically costs 3,500–9,700 SAR per room before flights. Arabic: https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/blog/egypt-family-holiday-guide-gulf/
- [Combining a holiday with medical treatment in Egypt: what Gulf families should know](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/holiday-and-treatment-in-egypt/): Treatment and holiday work best together when the treatment is planned, not urgent, and the doctor agrees the timing. A common plan is sightseeing first, then treatment in Cairo, then a quiet recovery stay by the Red Sea or in Ain Sokhna. Your doctor decides when you can swim, dive, sunbathe or fly. A recovery stay with transfers typically costs 2,700–5,650 SAR plus the treatment, which the clinic prices after reviewing your case. Arabic: https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/blog/holiday-and-treatment-in-egypt/
- [Need a doctor in Egypt? A practical guide for Gulf visitors and families](https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/doctor-in-egypt-for-gulf-visitors/): In a medical emergency in Egypt, call 123 for an ambulance. For non-emergencies — fever, stomach upset, heat exhaustion, a child’s infection, toothache — a licensed doctor, nurse or dentist can usually visit your hotel or see you the same day. Pharmacies are widespread and many open late. Keep your travel insurance details and any regular medicines with you. Arabic: https://www.hayakkom.com/ar/blog/doctor-in-egypt-for-gulf-visitors/
